Comment.Language: For the Commemoration of St. Takla Haymanout:

Text.Language: Hiten nieu,/ n~te peniwt eyouab n~dikeoc: abba Yekla Humanoy pip~recbuteroc: P~[oic arih~mot nan m~pi,w e~bol n~te nennobi.
Through the prayers of our saintly father and righteous, Abba Takla Haymanout the priest, O Lord, grant us the forgiveness of our sins.
بصلوات ابينا القديس الصديق البار تكلا هيمانوت القس. يارب انعم لنا بمغفرة خطايانا.
